title: EP_progressive_lod texture descriptor
description: Per-texture set of resolution LOD variants, ordered small-to-large by the client after load.

textureIndex.description: Index into the glTF textures array.

inline.description: sibling-file mode: true for the coarse base texture packed in the root asset.

path.description: sibling-file mode: path to the sibling texture file.

bufferView.description: single-glb-range mode: bufferView holding this texture LOD's image bytes.

mime.description: single-glb-range mode: image MIME type, e.g. image/webp.
